title: Ask
description: A request for a human key. Protocol sdk.syberlabs.space/v1alpha1. Field names follow MasterMind asks (asks/ASK-nnn.json): id, key, owner, opened, expires, question, options, default_on_silence, context. key adds approve, the per-effect approval a case already records as an approved event; direction, keys and tiebreak are the charter's three keys. An approve ask binds to the exact digest it authorizes and never takes effect on silence. A keys ask may carry a default on silence, as MasterMind's do, but that default is the option that performs no effect (for example ASK-009: Contact stays parked); the schema cannot tell options apart, so that rule is the ledger's. The answer is a commit or an approved event by a principal other than the proposer, never an edit to the ask.
